info.name: HustleHub+ API - Part 2
info.description:
Part 2 - Secure Stack. Covers authentication, RBAC (client / freelancer / admin), public browsing, gig ownership, bookings, simulated-payment transactions, reviews and ratings, contacting the team, income tracking, validation, sanitisation, JWT tampering, NoSQL-injection attempts and rate limiting.

Run with: npm run test:api (from /backend). Requires the API to run over HTTPS (self-signed cert => use --insecure).

exec: pm.test("Security: X-Powered-By is not exposed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has("X-Powered-By")).to.be.false; });

pm.test("Security: no internals leaked (stack traces, paths, driver errors)", function () { const body = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(body).to.not.match(/node_modules|MongoServerError|MongooseError|at .*\.js:\d+|\bstack\b|C:\\Users|\/home\//i); });

item.name: 00 - Health & security headers
item.description: API is reachable over HTTPS and sends hardened headers.

exec: pm.test("CSP is restrictive (default-src none, no framing)", function () { const csp = pm.response.headers.get("Content-Security-Policy"); pm.expect(csp).to.include("default-src 'none'"); pm.expect(csp).to.include("frame-ancestors 'none'"); });
pm.test("API responses are not cacheable", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.include("no-store"); });
pm.test("Uses the standard error format", function () { pm.expect(json.success).to.be.false; pm.expect(json.message).to.be.a("string"); });

item.description: Protected routes validate the token on every request.

exec: pm.test("Returns the logged-in user only", function () { pm.expect(json.data.user.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("c1Id")); });
const t = pm.collectionVariables.get("c1Token"); const flipped = t.slice(0, -3) + (t.slice(-3) === "AAA" ? "BBB" : "AAA");

item.name: Get current user - forged "alg: none" token claiming admin (invalid)

exec: const forged = b64({ alg: "none", typ: "JWT" }) + "." + b64({ id: pm.collectionVariables.get("c1Id"), role: "admin" }) + ".";

item.name: 03b - Two-factor authentication
item.description: Turning 2FA on/off, and the full login-with-2FA flow: backup codes, resend cooldown, and the pending token can never be used as a real session.

item.name: Enable - correct code (valid) - 8 backup codes issued, shown once

exec: pm.test("Eight distinct backup codes", function () { pm.expect(json.data.backupCodes).to.have.lengthOf(8); pm.expect(new Set(json.data.backupCodes).size).to.eql(8); });

item.name: Login now requires a code, not a direct session

exec: pm.test("Pending, not a real login", function () { pm.expect(json.data.requiresTwoFactor).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.data.token).to.be.undefined; });

item.name: SECURITY: the pending 2FA token cannot be used as a real session token
SECURITY: a pending 2FA token cannot be used to verify an EMAIL code either (wrong stage)
2FA verify - both a code and a backup code at once (invalid)
2FA verify - neither a code nor a backup code (invalid)
2FA resend - immediately hits the cooldown (a code was just issued at login)
2FA verify - REPLAYING the same code on the same pending token fails (invalid)
Log in again to get a fresh pending token for the backup-code path
2FA verify - an invalid backup code is rejected (invalid)
2FA verify - a valid, unused backup code succeeds (valid)
Log in a third time for the backup-code REUSE test
2FA verify - the SAME backup code cannot be used twice (invalid)
2FA verify - finish logging in with the email code so later requests are not blocked
Login is back to a direct session, no code required

05c - Contact the team
item.description: Anyone can message the team (no login needed). The route is rate limited, validated, escaped, has a spam trap, and only admins can read the inbox.

pm.test("Nothing else is echoed back", function () { pm.expect(Object.keys(json.data)).to.eql(["reference"]); });

item.name: Contact - a logged-in client can send one too

item.name: Inbox - admin sees the messages, newest first, with counts

exec: pm.test("Anonymous message is present and has no linked account", function () { const m = json.data.messages.find(x => x.reference === pm.collectionVariables.get("contactRef1")); pm.expect(m).to.exist; pm.expect(m.user).to.be.null; pm.expect(m.status).to.eql("new"); pm.expect(m.topic).to.eql("account"); });

pm.test("Logged-in message is linked to the real account", function () { const m = json.data.messages.find(x => x.reference === pm.collectionVariables.get("contactRef2")); pm.expect(m.user.role).to.eql("client"); pm.expect(m.user.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("c1Id")); });

pm.test("Markup was escaped in storage", function () { const m = json.data.messages.find(x => x.reference === pm.collectionVariables.get("contactRefXss")); pm.expect(m.message).to.not.include("<script>"); pm.expect(m.message).to.include("<script>"); pm.expect(m.name).to.not.include("<b>"); });

pm.test("Sender could not set status or user", function () { const m = json.data.messages.find(x => x.reference === pm.collectionVariables.get("contactRefSneaky")); pm.expect(m.status).to.eql("new"); pm.expect(m.user).to.be.null; });

pm.test("The spam-trap message from THIS run was not stored", function () { const botEmail = "bot." + pm.collectionVariables.get("runId") + "@example.com"; pm.expect(json.data.messages.some(x => x.email === botEmail)).to.be.false; });
pm.test("Counts per status are provided", function () { pm.expect(json.data.counts.new).to.be.at.least(4); pm.expect(json.data.counts).to.have.all.keys("new", "read", "resolved"); });
